description: AI-assisted platform for French public procurement (marchés publics): manage tenders (appel d'offres), build technical memories (mémoires techniques) against selection criteria, generate CERFA documents and enrich responses with Sirene company data.

userStories.title: Project Foundation: Next.js 15 App Router + Prisma Schema + Base Layout
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the Next.js 15 App Router project scaffolded with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma/SQLite schema and a sleek base layout so that all subsequent stories build on a stable foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs and next.config.ts exist with valid configuration

Dependencies installed: next, react, react-dom, typescript, tailwindcss, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, zod, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, prisma, @prisma/client
prisma/schema.prisma defines SQLite datasource with models: Organization, Tender, Criterion, TechnicalMemory, MemorySection, CerfaDocument, SireneCompany
lib/prisma.ts exports a singleton PrismaClient and lib/utils.ts exports cn() helper
app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, app/page.tsx render a modern landing page with components/Navbar.tsx and components/Footer.tsx using Tailwind styling
__tests__/layout.test.tsx passes under vitest
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
npm run build completes with 0 errors

userStories.title: Database Layer: Prisma Migrations & Seed Data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Prisma migrations applied to SQLite and seed data for organizations, tenders and criteria so that the app has realistic data to develop against.
acceptanceCriteria: prisma migrate dev runs successfully creating dev.db
prisma/seed.ts inserts at least one Organization, one Tender with Criteria and one TechnicalMemory with MemorySections
Seed is wired into package.json via prisma.seed config
npx prisma studio opens the database without errors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Backend API: Tender & Criterion Server Actions with Zod Validation
userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want typed server actions to list, create, update and delete tenders and criteria with Zod validation so that the UI has a safe data access layer.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/actions/tenders.ts exposes CRUD server actions validated with zod schemas from lib/schemas/tender.ts
Invalid payloads return structured error objects instead of throwing
Unit tests cover happy path and validation failure cases
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Tender Management UI: Dashboard List & Detail Pages
userStories.description: As a bidder, I want a dashboard listing my tenders with status badges and a detail page per tender showing its criteria so that I can track every appel d'offres in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: /tenders lists tenders fetched via server actions with responsive card grid styling
/tenders/[id] shows tender metadata and its Criterion list
Empty states are designed (no raw 'no data' text)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using Playwright MCP

userStories.title: Technical Memory Builder UI: Sections Editor per Criterion
userStories.description: As a bidder, I want an editor to draft MemorySection content answering each Tender criterion inside a TechnicalMemory so that I can compose my mémoire technique section by section.
acceptanceCriteria: /tenders/[id]/memory lets me create/edit/reorder MemorySections mapped to criteria
Section editor persists drafts via server actions with optimistic UI feedback
Word count per section is displayed
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using Playwright MCP

userStories.title: CERFA Document Generation & Sirene Company Enrichment
userStories.description: As a bidder, I want to generate a CerfaDocument from my completed TechnicalMemory and auto-fill company identity from the SireneCompany registry so that administrative forms are produced without manual retyping.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/cerfa generates a CerfaDocument record linked to a TechnicalMemory and returns a downloadable document
Sirene lookup endpoint resolves a SIREN into a SireneCompany record cached in SQLite
Generated document includes organization identity fields sourced from Sirene data
API errors return proper HTTP status codes with JSON bodies
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using Playwright MCP
